pins.title: Walking for Weight Loss: 4-Week Plan for Beginners
pins.description: Want to lose weight by walking? This simple 4-week walking plan for beginners shows you how long, how fast and how often to walk, plus easy tips to get more steps every day.

pins.title: How to Lose Weight by Walking (Beginner Plan)
pins.description: Walking is the easiest workout to start with: no gym, no equipment and easy on your joints. Follow this 4-week beginner plan and turn walking into a daily habit.
